
{{alias}}( value )
    Tests if an input value is an array of scale names.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Value to test.

    Returns
    -------
    bool: boolean
        Boolean indicating if an input value is an array of scale names.

    Examples
    --------
    > var bool = {{alias}}( [ 'linear' ] )
    true
    > bool = {{alias}}( {} )
    false

    --------
